desc: The TWM-852XL Xtreme Lumens Tactical Weapon-Mounted Long Gun Light uses an LED rated 850 lumens for 1.75 hours providing a beam distance of 245 meters. The rear-facing single switch provides both momentary and constant-on lighting operation. Serialized for personal identification. Designed to securely attach to a long gun Picatinny rail, the IP-X7 rated waterproof housing is constructed from aircraft-grade 6061-T6 aluminum. The TWM-852XL comes preinstalled with one set cross-rail inserts. Includes Allen wrench and 2 CR123 lithium-metal batteries. (Not compatible with rechargeable batteries.)
